chapters.title: Inside the Chip
chapters.subtitle: Registers, memory and math: the basics of every 6502 program.

units.title: Registers
learn: Load numbers into A, X and Y
Read and write hex numbers like $0A
Copy between registers and count with INX
units.goal: Set up the registers with as few loads as possible.

units.title: Memory
learn: Store registers with STA, STX and STY
Read memory and use the zero page
units.goal: Write and copy values in memory.

units.title: Math with the Carry
learn: Use the carry and count memory with INC
units.goal: Add up a whole shopping list.

chapters.title: Loops and Decisions
chapters.subtitle: Compare, branch and repeat: make the 6502 think.

units.title: Flags and Branches
learn: Read the zero and negative flags
units.goal: Make the program react to a value.

units.title: Loops
learn: Count down with DEX and BNE
Compare with CMP, CPX and CPY
Repeat code a set number of times
units.goal: Multiply two numbers with a loop.

units.title: Tables
units.goal: Find the highest score in a table.

chapters.title: Talking to the World
chapters.subtitle: Subroutines, the stack and the teletype.

units.title: Subroutines
learn: Call code with JSR and RTS
Save registers with PHA and PLA
units.goal: Write a subroutine and use it twice.

units.title: The Teletype
learn: Print whole messages from a table

units.title: Numbers on Paper
learn: Split numbers into tens and ones
units.goal: Print a score on the teletype.

chapters.title: Bits and Bytes
chapters.subtitle: Logic, shifts and multiplication without a multiply instruction.

units.title: Logic
learn: Set and flip bits with ORA and EOR

units.title: Multiplication
units.goal: Multiply two bytes into a 16-bit result.

chapters.title: Real Programs
chapters.subtitle: Bigger numbers, pointers and a game.

units.title: Pointers
learn: Write a print subroutine for any message
